title: Vampire Vape Rum Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Rum Tobacco Nic Salt combines the earthy richness of Tobacco with the warming character of spiced Rum. The Tobacco base delivers depth and body, while the Rum note adds a gentle sweetness that enriches the profile with subtle complexity. Formulated with nicotine salts for faster absorption and a smoother inhale, this 50VG/50PG e-liquid is perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, starter kits and vape pens. Nic Salts deliver a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, even at higher strengths. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Rum Tobacco Nic Salt is a versatile choice for vapers who want a distinctive Tobacco blend with a refined twist. Crafted in the UK, Vampire Vape are renowned for their creativity and reliability. Their Tobacco collection is designed for those who enjoy the familiar notes of Tobacco elevated with distinctive complementary flavours.
